name: iptv-api-plugin
description: Aggregate iptv-api M3U streams into same-name channels and clean stale sources.
author: Dispatcharr Community

fields.label: Channel Profile
fields.help_text: Runtime plugin.py replaces this with a select field. Leave empty to skip profile membership changes.

fields.label: Channel Group
fields.help_text: Channel group name used when creating channels.

fields.label: Max Streams Per Channel
fields.help_text: Maximum number of streams retained and linked for each channel.

fields.label: Cleanup Stale Streams
fields.help_text: Delete streams marked as is_stale after aggregation.

fields.label: Cleanup Orphan Streams
fields.help_text: Delete streams not linked to any channel. Custom streams excluded.

fields.label: Schedule Times (24-hour)
fields.help_text: Comma-separated times to run daily. Format HHMM, e.g. 0600,1300,1800.

fields.label: Dry Run Mode
fields.help_text: Preview changes without writing to database.

actions.label: Run Now
actions.description: Aggregate streams into channels and apply cleanup.

confirm.title: Run iptv-api aggregation?
confirm.message: This creates channels, changes stream mappings, and may delete stale streams.

actions.label: Preview
actions.description: Dry-run aggregation regardless of Dry Run Mode setting.

actions.label: Cleanup Now
actions.description: Run cleanup rules without rebuilding channel mappings.

confirm.title: Cleanup streams?
confirm.message: Stale and orphan streams may be deleted.

actions.label: Sync Schedule
actions.description: Create or update Celery Beat periodic schedule.
